description: Read the current Poindeo project state: scenes, points, subtitles, mosaics, audio tracks (incl. music library ids for audio.addMusic), transcription job and export status. Read IDs from here before modifying. state.recording.phase drives the recording flow: awaiting_user (panel open, user has not started — prompt them if it persists ~2 minutes), recording (capture in progress with elapsedSeconds — do not interrupt), result (a finished recording waits on the result page — ask the user and call recording.finish with scene/download/close), importing (extension/whiteboard reception), absent (idle / finished). When the phase clears and new scenes appear, continue editing (autozoom.replan for tracking scenes, autozoom.vision to apply your own frame-by-frame analysis to plain videos). user.loggedIn/user.subscribed drive export entitlements (the tier menu).
name: poindeo_get_project
